Vital

VY-tuhl · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Vital is so important that life or success depends on it.

Drinking water is vital when you play outside on a hot day.

Worked Example

Bees are vital to gardens because plants need them to make seeds.

Plants cannot make seeds without bees, so gardens truly need them. Something a thing cannot live or succeed without is vital.

How Vital Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

essential

essential: absolutely needed

necessary

necessary: required; must be there

Antonyms

unnecessary

unnecessary: not needed at all

needless

needless: having no good reason to exist

How Strong Is It? — Important → vital → Critical

Important vs. vital

Important vs. vital: Important is a lighter word: finishing your homework is important, but missing one night will not hurt you.

Critical vs. vital

Critical vs. vital: Critical is even stronger: in an emergency, calling for help right away is critical - every second counts.

Root Check

Word Choice

Vital is a strong word - save it for things that really matter, like safety and health. It is a close cousin of fundamental, which means basic and necessary.
